published_ranges._notes: Values from the TDS PDF at the cited URL, which now serves V5.5 (file name still says V5.4; 0.4 mm nozzle basis). Build surface PC and textured PEI (glue when needed); cooling fan ON. HDT 1.8 MPa 58 C. Sold in 1.75 mm and 2.85 mm (product page options). The Polymaker PLA Pro product page says it replaces PolyLite PLA Pro, which will be discontinued by end of 2026. bambu_parent is Bambu's toughened PLA (no Polymaker PLA Pro system preset in Bambu Studio).

conflicts: Older TDS V5.4 text on the Polymaker wiki (https://wiki.polymaker.com/polymaker-products/more-about-our-products/documents/technical-data-sheets/pla/polylite-tm-pla-pro): nozzle 190-220 C, density 1.22 g/cm3, retraction speed 30-60 mm/s, print speed 30-70 mm/s, Vicat 62.7 C, HDT 0.45 MPa 59.3 C / 1.8 MPa 57.6 C, BuildTak/glass/blue tape with glue or Magigoo, environmental temp 0-40 C, overhang threshold 60 deg; superseded by TDS V5.5 at the cited PDF URL
